## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Long

The system SHALL keep a very long requirement body that goes on and on so the validator sees more than five hundred characters of normative text in a single requirement, which OpenSpec now reports as a warning on ADDED requirements in a change delta as well as on main specs. It keeps going with more words, more clauses, more examples and more edge cases that really belong in scenarios, because a requirement should state one behavior and leave the examples to the scenarios below it, which is exactly what the new message says to do here.

#### Scenario: ok

- **WHEN** x
- **THEN** y
